verdicts.reason: A keeps a clean left edge, but it shrinks the content into the top 75% and leaves about 170px of empty space at the bottom. Its FREE DELIVERY badge floats loose between the body copy and the pills, the headline ends in an orphaned "back", and the GROVE wordmark and CTA text are tiny. B uses the canvas better with a larger product and a stronger headline, but it runs on three axes: GROVE is centred, the headline and copy are left-aligned, and the pills and CTA are right-aligned and crowd the right edge, so it looks arbitrary rather than designed.
